There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

translations.web: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not, for the sea was raging against them more and more.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous
translations.asv: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not: for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.
